question: What is the thickness of a graphene sheet?
answer: Graphene is a single sheet of carbon, only one atom thick. Pencil graphite is many of these sheets piled up, so it is three-dimensional. Graphene was discovered in 2004.
move: Graphene is a single sheet of carbon: one atom thick.

web.label: Asks: what is the thickness of a graphene sheet? A stack of carbon sheets, as in pencil graphite, sits on the page. Tapping peels them off one at a time until a single sheet, one atom thick, is left.
